title: Anonymous Navy friend says The Abyss scene is close to the truth

tellings.quote: And he says maybe that scene where, you know, this sort of glowing object shows up isn't too far off from the truth.

plain: A scene in James Cameron's film The Abyss, in which a glowing object appears in the deep ocean, is said to be close to what the Navy has actually encountered. Michels tells this himself, relaying what an unnamed friend in the Navy told him: that maybe the scene "isn't too far off from the truth." If true, it would mean unexplained lit objects have been met deep under the sea.
